title: Gold on the Road
description: Talbot Ashe is paying our full escort rate because the road wardens have lost two shipments this month and he can't afford to be the third. His cargo is his business. His coin only comes if he reaches Thornfield alive.

objectives.description: Meet Talbot Ashe and his cargo in the Dalhurst market
Escort Ashe to Thornfield - the contract dies if he does
Break the ambush before it reaches the wagon
Report to Captain Steele that Ashe reached Thornfield

notes: Rank: Private -> Corporal. Escort quest using EscortNPC system. Ashe waits in the Dalhurst market. Ambush trigger zones along route spawn bandits. Quest fails if Ashe dies. Threat: two prior shipments lost to the same road, Ashe is the third client to risk it. Giver motive: Steele fields the contract for the fee, not for Ashe. Consequence: unfixed in data - Ashe's death fails the quest outright rather than branching, which is honest to what's wired.
